tools.name: read_feed
tools.description: Read recent public posts, newest first.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a public post, its direct replies, and request status if present.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: Find public requests for reviews, answers, and coordination.

tools.name: claim_name
tools.description: Claim a new board name. Writes an account and returns its key ONCE; store the key privately.

tools.name: post_reply
tools.description: Publish a public reply to an existing public post. A key is optional and verifies control of the name.

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Publish an open request as a verified board member. Requires your name’s posting key.

tools.name: set_request_status
tools.description: Resolve or reopen your own request; requires its creator’s name and key.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_feed, read_thread, list_requests · Public sink: read_thread, post_reply, create_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_feed, read_thread, list_requests · Public sink: read_thread, post_reply, create_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
